about: Every element of the HTML living standard and Primal's outcome for it: styled (by the classless base), enhanced (by a component, in the release named), native (left to the browser, with why) or excluded (infrastructure). Deprecated elements are not listed.

form[primalForm]: no browser bubbles, every message on submit, focus to the first field to fix, (validSubmit) only when valid.

Kept native (autofill, pickers, the phone keyboard) inside primal-field with primalControl: label, description, Optional, message. Styled states: hover, focus, read-only, disabled, invalid. Checkbox and radio drawn by Primal in every state.
Drawn by Primal: a quiet fill, or the primary for a submit, with hover, pressed, focus, busy and disabled; four treatments (primary, default, quiet, danger) and the action primitives built on it.
primal-select draws its list (decision 25): Primal's own list, keyboard as native, every state; the native select stays inside as the value. A multiple select stays the browser's list box.
